decision_rule: Battery R3/R4/R5 rules (as R5-A): a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp written as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact (opening lines), rests on a premise no row states, lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; a clause on the source page but on no row is corrected. Bottleneck guesses are corrected only when they state as fact something no row supports or place another site's fact at the plant (ordering not checked on them). Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached (no live page, no archive). 'listed <date>' for board stamps (Workday startDate, UKG 'Posted on') and 'first listed <raw PostedDate>' are allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17); 'read <Month> [<day>,] <year>' is allowed where a cited row's retrieved_date carries it and is neutral for newest-first ordering. Live = in the board's own list today (Workday CXS jobs list; UKG LoadSearchResults; UKG Ready job-requisitions JSON). A closed posting written in the past tense with its own date and 'closed when read' is not 'as live'. City-level wording on a stated row of the plant, placing nothing at another site, is not a site misattribution.
